name: ios-sideload
title: iOS Sideload
description: Confirm and sideload configured iOS apps with Makefile-style build detection
author: nyaran2910

commands.name: index
commands.title: Renew iOS Sideloads
commands.description: Review build or update plan and sideload iOS apps

preferences.name: projectDirs
preferences.title: Project Directories
preferences.description: Semicolon-separated paths to iOS app project directories. Leave blank to load from ~/.config/raycast/ios-sideload.json.

preferences.name: defaultMode
preferences.title: Default Mode
preferences.description: How each app should be processed unless overridden per project.

data.title: Auto (Makefile: Build if sources changed, else Install)

preferences.name: teamId
preferences.title: Apple Team ID
preferences.description: Development team ID passed to xcodebuild and APPLE_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM. Leave blank to load from ~/.config/raycast/ios-sideload.json.

preferences.name: deviceId
preferences.title: Fallback Device UDID
preferences.description: Used if no paired physical device is auto-detected. Leave blank to load from ~/.config/raycast/ios-sideload.json.

preferences.name: alwaysRenewProvisioning
preferences.title: Renew Provisioning to 7 Days
preferences.label: Refresh provisioning profile to 7 days on every run
preferences.description: Evicts stale cached profiles and re-signs with a fresh 7-day profile when sources are unchanged.

preferences.name: profileExpiryHours
preferences.title: Fallback Renewal Threshold
preferences.description: Used when 'Renew Provisioning to 7 Days' is unchecked.

preferences.name: launchAfterInstall
preferences.title: Launch After Install
preferences.label: Launch app on device after installing
preferences.description: Automatically launch each installed app via devicectl.
